newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - HOTEL OLUMPIA H1 PROFIT UP 150 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - HOTEL OLUMPIA H1 PROFIT UP 150 PCT.

text.p: Hotel Olumpia, one of the largest hotels in Estonia, had a gross profit of 17.9 million kroons in the first six months of the year, up 150 percent compared to the same period last year, it said on Friday.
Its net turnover was 97 million kroons in the first half of the year, up 117 percent, the hotel's chairman, Tarmo Sumberg, told Reuters.
Sumberg said turnover exceeded the previous estimate by seven million kroons and profit by five million kroons.
Hotel Olumpia's council will discuss a possible increase in the 1997 profit estimate in August, Sumberg added.
During the first half of the year, an average of 63 percent of its rooms were filled, he said.
Hotel Olumpia's largest shareholder is the Baltic Republics Fund with 40 percent and Mercury Asset Management, which has a 20 percent stake.
Hotel Olumpia's state-owned minority shares are sold for vouchers and the subscription period closes on Friday.
